tasks.subject: Task 1: Enum peek on knob turn
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Turning a divable enum on the knob grid raises its option list as a self-decaying overlay, costing no IPC read and writing nothing of its own.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/page_controller.mjs` (TURN_CLAIM_MS line 169; onKnobTurn 1632; onKnobTouch; onJog; API object 2314)
- Modify: `src/shadow/shadow_ui_param_pages.mjs:617` (drawParamPages)
- Test: `tests/host/test_enum_peek.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Turning an enum with meta.divable and 2+ options makes controller.enumPeek() return {key, title, options, index}.
- [ ] enumPeek() returns null after ENUM_PEEK_MS (700); a further detent re-arms it.
- [ ] A non-enum, readOnly enum, or <2-option enum returns null.
- [ ] The peek path performs ZERO getParam calls.
- [ ] A knob touch, a jog, or a page change clears it immediately.
- [ ] The peek header's right-hand word is TURNING, not SELECT.

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_enum_peek.sh` -> exit 0

**Steps:** Write the test; add ENUM_PEEK_MS + s.peek; set s.peek in onKnobTurn (non-qualifying knob sets null); add enumPeek(nowMs) with expiry evaluated on READ; clear in onKnobTouch/onJog; export it; draw full-screen via drawEnumList after the grid render; full suite vs a main baseline; commit.

CRITICAL: an OVERLAY, not a view. The detent already wrote - a Back that cancelled it would be a lie. Do not route through VIEWS.ENUM_PICKER.

Full code: plan Task 1.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Knob LEDs - row identity and value intensity
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Each of the 8 knob LEDs shows its parameter's value as an intensity, with knobs 1-4 white and 5-8 amber so the physical encoder driving each grid row is identifiable at a glance.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/shared/param_pages/knob_leds.mjs`
- Modify: `src/shadow/shadow_ui_param_pages.mjs` (tickParamPages 259; exitParamPages 230)
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/viz_draw.mjs` (export fractionOf)
- Test: `tests/host/test_knob_leds.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Knobs 0-3 white (124/118/120); knobs 4-7 amber (75/29/6/3).
- [ ] An unbound knob is colour 0.
- [ ] An unchanged colour emits no MIDI.
- [ ] resetKnobLedCache() re-emits every knob.
- [ ] LEDs reset to 0 on exitParamPages.

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_knob_leds.sh` -> exit 0

**Steps:** Write the test (asserts disjoint scales, no value maps to 0, bucket boundaries, send counts 16/0/2/16); port knob_leds.mjs from movy knob-leds.ts with its OWN diff cache and force=true; drive from tickParamPages off controller.state.values (cached - 8 reads would cost ~22ms against a 16ms frame), only on PAGE_KNOBS; export fractionOf from viz_draw as normalizedOf rather than writing a second normaliser; clear+reset in exitParamPages; HARDWARE check and settle which LED address is real; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Sample cell - marker anchoring and loop brackets
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The sample cell appears whenever a position or loop marker is on the page (not only when a file param is), collects every marker on the same sample, and draws loop bounds as inward-facing brackets.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/viz.mjs:456-479` (detectSample)
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/viz_draw.mjs:851-875` (drawSample)
- Test: `tests/host/test_viz_sample.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A page with a wav_position and no file param produces a VIZ_SAMPLE group.
- [ ] A float/int declaring filepath_param is recognised as a marker.
- [ ] roles.loopStart/loopEnd filled by name, with end/stop/finish/to selecting the closing bracket.
- [ ] Markers grouped by view_group first, shared file second.
- [ ] Bracket tips point INWARD; the cursor draws ON TOP of them.

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_viz_sample.sh` -> exit 0

**Steps:** Write the test pinning bracket tip COLUMNS on the framebuffer; rewrite detectSample anchored on the MARKER (an all-loop page is the page that most needs the picture); isSprayMeta matches the key EXACTLY (granny's `spread` is stereo width and would show a region the DSP never reads); trim to a contiguous slot run using detectEnvelope's isAdjacentRun idiom; add colOf/posOf/bracket to drawSample, brackets FIRST and cursor LAST; RENDER TO PNG AND LOOK; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Granular spray fences
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Where a granular sampler declares a `spray` amount, draw the region grains are actually taken from as a dotted fence either side of the cursor.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/viz_draw.mjs` (drawSample)
- Test: `tests/host/test_viz_sample.sh` (append)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] With spray > 0, two dotted fences appear either side of the cursor.
- [ ] Fence positions WRAP: cursor 0.9 + spray 0.2 puts the upper fence at 0.1.
- [ ] At spray >= 0.5 the fences pin to the file edges.
- [ ] spray === 0 or no spray role draws nothing - and a `spread` at 1.0 draws nothing either.
- [ ] A fence pixel inside the waveform body is CUT (0), not added.

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_viz_sample.sh` -> exit 0

**Steps:** Append the spray block (includes `spread` as a DECOY that must draw nothing); insert the fence block BETWEEN the bracket calls and the cursor block, hoisting `const pos = posOf("position")`; copy granny's engine behaviours rather than guessing (max_offset spans the whole file; start_idx wraps; +/-0.5 already reaches every frame so past that the fences pin); RENDER TO PNG AND LOOK; commit.

Full code: plan Task 4.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Framed numbers for small ints
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Octave offsets, transposes and voice counts render as a framed number showing sign and value (+2, -1), instead of an arc you have to interpret.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/render_page_movy.mjs` (add drawFramedNumber, shouldFrameNumber, framedNumberText; branch in drawKnobWidget line 1153)
- Test: `tests/host/test_framed_number.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] An int with range span <= 128 renders framed, not as an arc.
- [ ] A positive value on a range with a negative side shows +; zero shows 0 with no sign.
- [ ] A unipolar int (1..8) renders framed with NO sign.
- [ ] A float, an enum, and a wide int (0..20000) never render framed.
- [ ] A null value renders `--`, never 0.
- [ ] The frame is a 1px rectangle with digits inside, clipped() === 0.
- [ ] test_param_pages_movy.sh still passes, including the geometry baseline.

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_framed_number.sh && bash tests/host/test_param_pages_movy.sh` -> exit 0

**Steps:** Write the test (predicate/text block, then a framebuffer block); add FRAME_MAX_SPAN/shouldFrameNumber/framedNumberText/drawFramedNumber near drawEnumSquare; branch in drawKnobWidget BEFORE drawArcKnob and AFTER the enum/opaque branches; if the geometry baseline fails, look at a PNG before refreshing with UPDATE_GEOM_BASELINE=1; RENDER AND LOOK; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Real WAV peak envelope
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the synthetic envelope in drawSample with the file's actual peak envelope, computed a little per tick and cached.

**GATE RESOLVED:** std.open/seek/read is already in the shadow_ui context (js_init_module_std in JS_NewCustomContext, js_host_common.c:41). host_read_file slurps whole files and is NOT usable - a multi-megabyte read in one 60Hz tick is felt as input lag. No new host binding needed.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/shared/param_pages/wav_peaks.mjs`
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/viz_draw.mjs` (drawSample uses real points)
- Modify: `src/shadow/shadow_ui_param_pages.mjs` (tickParamPages advances the job)
- Test: `tests/host/test_wav_peaks.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Parses RIFF/WAVE and FORM/AIFF(-C) from the first 4 KB.
- [ ] Resumable: each advance() does a bounded number of blocks.
- [ ] O(width) memory regardless of file length.
- [ ] Files past MAX_BLOCKS are strided - fixed ceiling on total work.
- [ ] Cache key is path:size:mtime:width.
- [ ] An unreadable file sets error/done and drawSample falls back to the synthetic envelope.

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_wav_peaks.sh && bash tests/host/test_viz_sample.sh` -> exit 0

**Steps:** Read /tmp/movy-src/src/model/wav-peaks.ts (re-clone if gone); write the test (generates a known 1s WAV, silent first half); port the module keeping the three-constraints doc comment and parseRiff/parseAiff verbatim; add the SYNCHRONOUS openFile adapter (globalThis.std on-device, node:fs under test, loaded via try/catch'd top-level await import); use peaksFor in drawSample with the synthetic shape as fallback; advance the job from tickParamPages NEVER from the draw; HARDWARE check param_pages fps and then rm debug_log_on; commit.

Full code: plan Task 6.
